wayback._eras_pending: Kickoff 2026-09-30: the Internet Archive is under a machine-wide cooldown (~5.2 h at kickoff). The archive layer starts on Common Crawl (scratch/cc-cluster.py over the static cluster.idx, including the 2008-2009, 2009-2010 and 2012 ARC collections) and the Wayback eras are written once the archive answers.

roster._note: The roster is curated (sources/wayback/partner-roster.json) from the Companies House member registers of the manager and the fund vehicles (exact appointment and cessation dates: Seedcamp Investment Management LLP OC391626 from 2014-03-04, Seedcamp Investments LLP OC331184 and Seedcamp Investments II LLP OC355777 from 2007 and 2010, Seedcamp Limited 06367351 from 2007-09-11), the live team page (sources/site/team-cards.json, 2026-09-30) and the archived team pages when the archive answers.

site_api._entry_stage_note: The live list publishes the firm's own 'Year of Investment' per company and no round word, so there is no field to score or promote (COLLECTION.md s5: a bare year is an anchor, not a label). Round words come from the Views posts (class 1 for the round a post names) and from the programme terms (decisions.md D5).
site_api._note: seedcamp.com (2026) is WordPress; the company post type is not in the REST API and the list ships server-rendered in one page (327 companies read 2026-09-30 by scratch/site-live.py). The firm says 'more than 550 company journeys' (FAQs), so roughly 40% of the book is recovered from the archive eras and the Views posts. views-cohorts: the programme years' invested cohorts (2007-2017) as the firm announced them in the Views posts, hand-curated at kickoff (scratch/views-cohorts.py; decisions.md D2, D3).

edgar._note: Kickoff 2026-09-30, EDGAR company search: SEEDCAMP V L.P. (CIK 1830158, one Form D of 2020-11-04 from 5 Bonhill Street, London) and 27 series of AngelList's master vehicles 'AL-Seedcamp-Funds, LP/LLC' and 'AngelList-Seedcamp-Funds, LLC' (single-company syndicate SPVs whose names encode the company: 9F Fund I, Tise-Fund, JUR Fund I, ...; decisions.md D6). Adviser: Seedcamp Investment Management LLP, exempt reporting adviser CRD 330799, SEC 802-130331.

desks._note: One adviser, Seedcamp Investment Management LLP (CRD 330799), for Seedcamp III to VI and the SC_3/SC_4 opportunity vehicles; Funds I and II (Seedcamp Investments LLP and Seedcamp Investments II LLP) were run by Seedcamp Limited with the same partners (decisions.md D1). The AngelList syndicate series are the firm's syndicate, advised by AngelList's adviser (D6).
